text:
oliver: Heads-up — planning a coordinated cutover for API v1.8.2, runtime 2.5.1, console UI patch, and router pinning. Change window 2026-03-25 02:00-03:00 UTC. Any blockers?

maria: ack the window. I'm good but raising that runtime has a minor kernel change; will need a health-check tweak.

raj: router team requests pin to router@3.2.0-compat during migration (no auto-upgrade). Can we do that for the first 30m?

oliver: yes — plan: router pinned to 3.2.0-compat for initial 30m, then unpin to allow normal autoscale. API pinned to 1.8.2, runtime staged rollout 10/30/60. Console deploy will be feature-flagged (ui-flags:enable-new-dashboard=false).

emma: SLOs and rollback criteria? We should be explicit.

sre-oncall: rollback triggers: sustained 5xx rate >1% for 5m, p50 latency increase >200ms over baseline for 10m, or any customer-reported auth regressions. If triggered, we roll runtime back first, then router.

maria: runtime health-check tweak: increase readiness timeout to 45s for the new kernel path. I'll push the config patch to infra repo now.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by oliver — release/api@1.8.2 starting canary to api-cluster-a (10%).

deploy-bot: canary success (api v1.8.2) — 5m metrics OK. Proceeding to 30% across regions.

raj: router pin applied to cluster-router-prod-1: router@3.2.0-compat (reason: session affinity change). :thumbsup:

oliver: runtime rollout plan: stage1 (10%): 02:10 UTC, stage2 (30%): 02:20, global (60%+): 02:35. Hold for 10m at each stage to validate.

emma: adding release notes link: https://redwood.docs/release/1.8.2 — includes breaking note about header normalization and recommended client patch.

maria: pushed readiness patch: 
```yaml
containers:
  - name: runtime
    readinessProbe:
      timeoutSeconds: 45
```

oliver: rollback commands (if needed):
```bash
# rollback runtime to previous revision
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=42
# unpin router (if router update caused issues)
kubectl -n router set image daemonset/router router=router:3.1.9
```

sre-oncall: oncall will monitor metrics and paging rules. I have alert runbook open. Ping me @sre-oncall if anything purple.

deploy-bot: runtime stage1 complete — 10% success. Metrics: 0.2% 5xx, p50 +30ms. Holding.

raj: router logs look normal. No session breakage on canary.

oliver: sweet. If hold after stage2 looks good, we'll unpin router at +30m. Agreed owners: oliver (release lead), maria (runtime), raj (router), emma (api/notes), sre-oncall (monitoring).

emma: :partyparrot: good luck team — will update release notes post-unpin.

oliver: closing thread — will post final postmortem if rollback or notable regressions. Thanks all.
